options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

options.doc_fr:

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: McGuffin Count
options.doc:
Currently, the main goal of apAdventure is to collect all McGuffin items.
This setting controls how many of these items will exist in the item pool.

If this is set to a higher number than the amount of free space in
the item pool the generator will only place as many as it can fit.
options.doc_fr:
Actuellement, le but principal de apAdventure est de collecter tous les éléments McGuffin.
Ce réglage contrôle combien de ces éléments existeront dans le pool d'éléments.

Si ce nombre est supérieur à la quantité d'espace libre dans le pool de l'article, le générateur ne placera que le plus grand nombre possible.

options.name: Skill
options.doc:
Sets the internal "skill" variable, which is mainly used for difficulty settings
in the Half-Life games.

In Half-Life: Source, enemies will gain more health and deal more damage at higher skill settings.

In Half-Life 2, enemies will deal more damage at higher difficulties and ammo gain from pickups is reduced.

Players will also deal less damage against enemies from both games at higher difficulties.
(This may not be intended behavior for HL1 enemies, but this is how GMod handles it.)

Outside of Half-Life, lua coders and map makers are also able to check what this value is set to
and have their code/maps behave differently depending on it, but this is not very common.

options.name: Custom Parameters
options.doc: This option allows you to set custom parameters which item sets or map configs may use for various purposes.

options.name: Bunnyhop
options.doc:
GMods Sandbox gamemode (which this gamemode derives from internally) normally clamps
the players movement speed when they jump off the ground to prevent Bunnyhopping.

Choosing "never" maintains this behavior, "item" removes it after
receiving an item and "always" will disable it from the start.

The latter two options also provide an autohop.
options.doc_fr:
GMods Sandbox gamemode (que ce mode de jeu dérive de l'intérieur) normalement serre la vitesse de mouvement des joueurs quand ils sautent du sol pour empêcher Bunnyhopping.

Choisir "jamais" maintient ce comportement, "item" le supprime après avoir reçu un élément et "toujours" le désactivera dès le début.

Ces deux dernières options offrent également un autohop.

options.name: Bunnyhop Logic
options.doc:
Determines how hard Bunnyhops are allowed to be before they are considered out of logic.

This difficulty rating is oriented around Momentum Mods tier system, with 1 being the easiest
and 10 being the hardest. Although unlike Momentum Mod, apAdventure allows fractional values for
more granularity.

Setting this to 0, lower or any other value that can not be converted into a number
puts all BHops out of logic. Ignored if bhop is set to "never
options.doc_fr:
Détermine comment les Bunnyhops sont autorisés à être difficiles avant qu'ils ne soient considérés comme hors de la logique.

Cette cote de difficulté est orientée autour du système de niveau Momentum Mods, 1 étant le plus facile et 10 étant le plus difficile. Bien que contrairement à Momentum Mod, apAdventure permet des valeurs fractionnelles pour plus de granularité.

Définir ceci à 0, valeur inférieure ou toute autre valeur qui ne peut pas être convertie en un nombre met tous les BHops hors de la logique. Ignoré si bhop est mis à "jamais

options.name: Surf Logic
options.doc:
Determines how hard surfs are allowed to be before they are considered out of logic.

This difficulty rating is oriented around Momentum Mods tier system, with 1 being the easiest
and 10 being the hardest. Although unlike Momentum Mod, apAdventure allows fractional values for
more granularity.

Setting this to 0, lower or any other value that can not be converted into a number
puts all surfs out of logic.
options.doc_fr:
Détermine la façon dont les surfeurs sont autorisés à être avant qu'ils ne soient considérés comme hors de la logique.

Cette cote de difficulté est orientée autour du système de niveau Momentum Mods, 1 étant le plus facile et 10 étant le plus difficile. Bien que contrairement à Momentum Mod, apAdventure permet des valeurs fractionnelles pour plus de granularité.

Régler cela à 0, valeur inférieure ou toute autre valeur qui ne peut pas être convertie en un nombre met tous les surfs hors de la logique.

options.name: Config Groups
options.doc:
Config Groups to use for generation.

Map configs are used by apAdventure to tell the generator what the maps the player wants to play on contain
and where the gamemode should place exits, locations and whatever else the config creator wants to include
in their config.

Configs are organized into groups so maps related to each other (such as maps from the same chapter in HL2)
can be grouped together and share certain settings.

Not all configs are enabled by default. If you want to see what configs are available, you can use the
"apAdventure - Generate Map Index" tool in your launcher to get a list of all available config groups
and the maps in them.
options.doc_fr:
Config Groupes à utiliser pour la génération.

Les configurations de cartes sont utilisées par apAdventure pour dire au générateur ce que les cartes que le joueur veut jouer sur contiennent et où le mode de jeu devrait placer les sorties, les emplacements et tout ce que le créateur de configuration veut inclure dans sa configuration.

Les configs sont organisés en groupes, de sorte que les cartes sont reliées les unes aux autres (comme les cartes du même chapitre dans HL2)
peut être groupé et partager certains paramètres.

Toutes les configurations ne sont pas activées par défaut. Si vous voulez voir quelles configs sont disponibles, vous pouvez utiliser l'outil "apAdventure - Generate Map Index" dans votre lanceur pour obtenir une liste de tous les groupes de config disponibles et les cartes dans eux.

options.name: Config Cherrypicking
options.doc:
This option allows you to cherrypick single maps from a config group.

Check the options guide for more information on how this option works.

options.name: Config Blacklist
options.doc:
This option allows you to pick maps from a Config Group that should not be added to your run.

The defaults for this setting contain some maps that don't play very well in this mode, but still
had configs made for them for the sake of covering all maps.

Blacklisting maps that have not actually been added through the previous options
should not cause problems.

Check the options guide for more information on how this option works.

options.name: start_group
options.doc:
What group your starting map should be picked from. Normally, your starting map is picked at random
from all maps that have starting points set, but this option lets you set a filter for a certain group.

An empty string (the default setting) disables the filter.

This option mainly exists for cases where the same map exists in multiple groups,
you probably won't have to set this.

options.name: start_map
options.doc:
The name of your starting map. Functions similarly to the start_group setting,
but filters after the map name instead.

Looks for the file name of the map. (ap_orange, gm_construct, etc., without extensions)

Currently, apAdventure only includes a single starting map, so you won't have to set
this option unless you have made your own configs with starting points.

options.name: start_region
options.doc:
If your selected starting map has start points placed in multiple regions,
you can use this setting to chose what region you want to start in.

The starting map included with apAdventure does not have multiple starting regions,
so you can ignore this option unless you have made your own configs with
multiple starting regions.
options.doc_fr:
Si votre carte de départ sélectionnée a des points de départ placés dans plusieurs régions, vous pouvez utiliser ce paramètre pour choisir la région dans laquelle vous voulez commencer.

La carte de départ incluse avec apAdventure n'a pas plusieurs régions de départ, vous pouvez donc ignorer cette option à moins d'avoir fait vos propres configs avec plusieurs régions de départ.

options.name: Item Sets
options.doc:
Item sets to use for generation.

Similarly to map configs, items related to each other are grouped together in item sets.

Not all item sets are enabled by default. If you want to see what sets are available, you can use the
"apAdventure - Generate Item Index" tool in your launcher to get a list of all available item sets
and the items in them.

The generator will automatically check which of the items chosen are relevant to progression
and remove items that are not logically required if there is not enough space for them.
This process is not perfect though, the generator just checks if the item can fullfill
any logic rule, but it doesn't check if there is another item that could also satisfy
that rule, so if multiple items exist that can pass the same conditions the generator will
keep all of then, even if the run could be beaten with only one of them.
options.doc_fr:
Ensembles d'éléments à utiliser pour la génération.

De même que les configurations cartographiques, les éléments liés les uns aux autres sont regroupés en ensembles d'éléments.

Tous les ensembles d'éléments ne sont pas activés par défaut. Si vous voulez voir quels jeux sont disponibles, vous pouvez utiliser l'outil "apAdventure - Generate Item Index" dans votre lanceur pour obtenir une liste de tous les jeux d'articles disponibles et les éléments dans eux.

Le générateur vérifie automatiquement lequel des éléments choisis est pertinent pour la progression et supprime les éléments qui ne sont pas logiquement nécessaires s'il n'y a pas assez d'espace pour eux.
Ce processus n'est cependant pas parfait, le générateur vérifie simplement si l'élément peut remplir n'importe quelle règle logique, mais il ne vérifie pas s'il y a un autre élément qui pourrait également satisfaire cette règle, donc si plusieurs éléments existent qui peuvent passer les mêmes conditions que le générateur gardera tous alors, même si la course pourrait être battue avec un seul d'entre eux.

options.name: Item Cherrypicking
options.doc:
This option allows you to cherrypick single items from an item set.

Check the options guide for more information on how this option works.

options.name: Item Blacklist
options.doc:
This option allows you to blacklist single items from an item set.

Check the options guide for more information on how this option works.

options.name: Filler Weight Override
options.doc:
You can adjust how likely the generator is to pick certain items when
the remaining space in the item pool is being filled here.

Consult the item index to see which items are filler items,
filler items will have their default weight listed next to them.
This option has no effect on non-filler items.

Trying to override weights of items that haven't been loaded will not cause errors.
You also don't have to define these for all filler items you've loaded,
the defaults here only exist to illustrate how this option should be used.

options.name: Starting Item Groups
options.doc:
What types of starting items you want.

Items may be marked as being part of a certain start item group.
You can enter the name of one of these groups here to be granted one item of each type.
You will also always be granted a starting melee weapon.

Currently, the available item types are "Pistol","Shotgun","Magnum","SMG" and "Grenade".
Custom item sets may also add their own types.

options.name: Ammo Merge
options.doc:
This option allows ammo types to be merged together.

Whenever the player gains or loses ammo for a merged type,
all merged types will also be set to the same amount, and
whenever ammunition of a merged type is available logically,
the generator will also consider all merged types to be available.

This feature mainly exists for Half-Life: Source, which uses
separate ammo types from HL2. Note that not all HL2 ammo types
have a HL:S counterpart.

A list of all of GMods default ammo types can be found here:
https://wiki.facepunch.com/gmod/Default_Ammo_Types

Alternatively, apAdventure also provides a console command
called "apadventure_dump_ammotypes" that will dump the names
of all currently existing ammo types, which can be used to figure
out the names of ammo types that have been added by addons.

options.name: Trap Vision
options.doc:
Archipelago items that physically exist in apAdventure will give off particles depending on
what flags have been set on them. This setting controls whether or not the player will be able
to see these particles on trap items. The "item" option also allows this ability to be enabled
after receiving an item for it.
options.doc_fr: Les objets d'archipel qui existent physiquement dans apAdventure donneront des particules selon les drapeaux qui leur ont été fixés. Ce réglage contrôle si le lecteur sera en mesure de voir ces particules sur des objets pièges. L'option « item » permet également d'activer cette capacité après avoir reçu un item pour elle.

options.name: Testing Mode
options.doc:
Removes some restrictions the gamemode normally places on you to make testing easier:

- Entering a map you haven't accessed through a map transition before
  will not send you back to your starting map.
- While sv_cheats is enabled, you may pick up weapons normally,
  even if you have not received an item to unlock them yet.

More functionality may be added to this option in the future.

options.name: inaccessible_warning
options.doc:
The apworld for apAdventure preprocesses access rules to determine if they can even
be fulfilled by the player with their current settings and removes whatever they're
attached to if they can't.

While config makers can use this to have their configs adjust to YAML options,
they may unintentionally make things inaccessible because of this, so this option can be
used to have the generator write a warning into [seed name]_[slot name]_warnings.txt
in the generator output whenever an access rule is determined to be inaccessible.

options.name: Generate PUML
options.doc:
Generates a PlantUML diagram showing all of the worlds regions and locations,
which may be helpful for debugging configs you've made.
options.doc_fr: Génère un diagramme PlantUML qui montre toutes les régions et tous les emplacements du monde, ce qui peut être utile pour déboguer les configs que vous avez faits.
